It has high static friction when resting on surfaces due to the rough, slightly hairy texture of the leaves and stem, but low restitution (bounciness) because it is soft and flexible. For collision in a rigid body simulation, a complex shape like this requires either a highly simplified bounding box/hull if considered a single rigid object, or a convex decomposition if trying to capture the general shape of the leaves, though a bounding box is often sufficient for such a small, lightweight debris-like object. In this case, we'll estimate a lightweight rigid body, though in reality, it would be highly deformable.
